pass_a_gloss: Make-wonderful the mercies of-you, the one-saving the ones-hoping upon you; out-of the ones-having-stood-against to-the right-hand of-you keep me, as pupil of-eye. Just-as the having-struck him power, the Job hand says of-God: The hand is of-you, he-says, not me let-it-whirl so-much. pass_b_english: “Make wonderful your mercies, you who save those who hope on you; from those who have stood against your right hand, keep me as the pupil of the eye” (Psalm 16:7).

Just as Job calls the power that struck him the hand of God: “Your hand,” he says, “let it not whirl me so much.” And David calls the enemies of the beneficent hand of God the sword of God. And the beneficent hand of God is the angels, through whom the perceptible world is provided for, to whom demons are opposed, [the angels] wishing all men to be saved and to come to knowledge of the truth (1 Timothy 2:4).

choices.why: Hand of providence is angels; demons oppose them. Not ‘God’s hand is a demon’.
